title: quilt.organ.manifest/v1 — THE canonical quilt organ bundle dialect
description: L15 unification registration. Before this document there were two organ-bundle dialects: quilt-jev-toolkit spoke quilt.organ.manifest/v1 (manifest law) and quilt-organ-workers validated quilt.organ.v1 (bundle law). This document registers ONE schema string and ONE canonical bundle shape that BOTH implementations validate against. The canonical manifest body is the toolkit's manifest law VERBATIM (validateManifest / computeManifestHash / verifyChain / canonicalJson accept it unmodified); the bundle envelope, the store content-address law (organ id = sha256hex(canonicalJSON(manifest))) and the whole-state commitment (manifest.stateHash) come from the worker law. The legacy worker dialect quilt.organ.v1 remains accepted by the organ-boot-loader during transition (response header x-quilt-schema-deprecated) and /verify always reports which dialect a stored organ was served as.

deprecated.note: PUT responses for legacy-dialect bundles carry x-quilt-schema-deprecated: quilt.organ.v1; new uploaders MUST use the canonical dialect.

canonicalization.keys: recursively sorted lexicographically by code unit (Object.keys().sort())
failClosed: undefined is illegal (JSON has no stable meaning for it)
bigint / function / symbol are illegal (serialize explicitly as string)
canonicalization.numbers: IEEE-754 doubles exactly as JSON.stringify emits them on V8 (node + workerd agree on all finite doubles)
canonicalization.hash: sha256, lowercase hex, over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical form
implementations: quilt-jev-toolkit src/organ/manifest.mjs canonicalJson() — the reference law
organ-boot-loader worker canonical() — fail-closed, byte-identical on all JSON-representable values (proven by scripts/validate-dialect.mjs cross-canonicalizer battery)

identityLaws.storeContentAddress: organ id = sha256hex(canonicalJSON(manifest)) — over the FULL manifest INCLUDING its internal manifestHash field; derived SERVER-SIDE on PUT, never client-chosen; identical manifest => identical id (PUT idempotent)
identityLaws.manifestSelfCover: manifest.manifestHash = sha256hex(canonicalJSON(manifest minus manifestHash)) — the toolkit's self-cover; covers every registered extension field too
identityLaws.organId: name@16hex where 16hex = sha256hex(canonicalJSON({name, material})).slice(0,16); registered fixture binds material = manifest.stateHash (deterministic content derivation)

stateCommitments.manifest.stateHash: sha256hex(canonicalJSON(bundle.state)) — WHOLE-state commitment (worker heritage); server re-derives on PUT and /verify
stateCommitments.manifest.cells[i].stateHash: sha256hex(canonicalJSON(bundle.state.cells[cells[i].id])) when bundle.state.cells is a plain object map — per-cell commitment; server re-derives and requires every cell id to be present in the map

receiptLaw.shape: { seq: integer, op: { type: string(non-empty), ... }, prev: string, hash: hex64 }
receiptLaw.hash: receipts[i].hash = sha256hex(canonicalJSON({seq, op, prev})) — the toolkit's receiptHash law; op is an OBJECT and carries ALL effect content (op.type is the legacy op string; legacy sibling fields cell/payload moved INSIDE op) so the single hash covers the full receipt
receiptLaw.chain: receipts[0].prev == manifest.genesis.prevHash ('GENESIS' for fresh chains); receipts[i].prev == receipts[i-1].hash; receipts[i].seq == manifest.receiptRange.start + i; receipts.length == manifest.receiptRange.count (a bootable organ carries its FULL window)
receiptLaw.verification: quilt-jev-toolkit verifyChain(receipts, {expectedStart: receiptRange.start, expectedPrev: genesis.prevHash}) — unmodified toolkit primitive

fixtureProvenance: the greeter organ from receipts/DEPLOYMENT.md (2 cells / 3 EFFECT receipts, 'hello quilt' / 'hello organ' / 'hello quilt-organ') re-expressed in the canonical dialect by fixture/make-organ-manifest-fixture.mjs (deterministic, fixed createdAt). The legacy-dialect fixture fixture/greeter-organ.json is preserved untouched as the transition exemplar.
